_comment: Candidate freeze for the Gate F run of 2026-08-27. Frozen from main at f082bdf6, which carries the grass consolidation (762,058-placement bake), the Sigil Gate wing fix, the stuck-check fix, the CI work, and the previous lane's engage diagnostics. This OVERWRITES the 2026-08-26 freeze at 14e88c7c, which the 2026-08-26 evening handover section 3 declares VOID. Nothing from the aborted gate-f-run-20260826T110000Z may be spliced into this run (section 1.6): all of it belongs to 14e88c7c, which is not the candidate. S01 is re-run from scratch.

supersedes.why: Declared void by ralph/reports/GATE_F_HANDOVER_2026-08-26_EVENING.md section 3. That candidate predates the grass consolidation, the Sigil Gate fix, the stuck-check fix and the CI work.

binary.kind: linux editor binary, NOT the shipped Windows export
binary._comment: Section 0.5: this run uses the Linux editor binary. tools/verify_export.sh and CI prove the Windows export builds; export-identity behaviour on Windows is [OWNER-ONLY].

renderer: opengl3 / Compatibility under xvfb — Mesa 25.2.8 llvmpipe (LLVM 20.1.2, 256 bits), software rasterisation
_comment_resolution: Section A.4 capture smoke (tools/capture_diag_minimal.gd) PASSED at the requested 1920x1080 on this container; the 1280x800 fallback was not needed and nothing is recorded as substituted. 1920x1080 matches ROG Ally native.
input_mode: synthetic joypad + keyboard via Input.parse_input_event, paired with Input.action_press/release
_comment_free_build: Verified, not assumed: autoload/game_state.gd:266 defaults free_build to false and autoload/game_state.gd:280 defaults debug_teleport to false. Both persist only in user://settings.json, which S01-02's wipe_saves clears. Teleport is therefore off everywhere except where a DIAG- segment turns it on deliberately (section 0.6).
instrumentation_overhead_note: Measured on this container with tools/gate_f/run_segment.sh --overhead at the candidate SHA, scene=world, 30 s x 2 windows per condition at [-25.4, 4.93, -15.6], order off/telemetry/recording/recording/telemetry/off (reversed to cancel drift). Means: off 4.341, telemetry 3.945, telemetry+recording@0.50Hz 4.039 ms/frame. Both deltas vs off came out NEGATIVE (telemetry -0.396, recording -0.302) and are below the noise floor of 0.717 ms/frame, taken as the widest a single condition disagreed with itself. Read these as 'under ~0.72 ms/frame', NOT as zero and NOT as a speed-up. IMPORTANT GAP: frames written 0, so the recorder's framebuffer-grab-and-encode cost was NOT measured directly, and the frame-time difference cannot resolve a ~1 ms/frame effect against this noise floor. CPU frame time on this container only — no device fps, no GPU frame time, no VRAM.

suite_state_at_freeze._comment: Section A.4 makes 'the full test suite is green at the SHA' a COORDINATOR precondition discharged before the freeze, not an operator step, and section 13 forbids the operator substituting a unit-test result for player-path evidence. It was not re-run here: this container was provisioned bare and the suite's test_harvest.gd job alone carries 684,231 assertions. This field exists so Phase B reads the actual state rather than an implied green.
suite_state_at_freeze.known_open_defect: tests/smoke_party_count_after_catches.gd fails INTERMITTENTLY with 'could not engage the real wild body at Wild_bramblebun_0_3 (stopped 23.7m away (engage range 6.0m))'. Open at freeze time, carried forward from the 2026-08-26 evening handover section 2, where four hypotheses are recorded as killed with the measurement that killed each. The failure is self-diagnosing at this SHA via _why_the_engage_failed. NOT an operator concern during the run: if it fires it is recorded and the run continues (section 13).

envelope_facts_confirmed_on_this_contain.audio: NONE. All ALSA drivers failed to initialise (cannot find card '0', libpulse.so.0 absent) and Godot fell back to the dummy audio driver. Section K.6 audio coverage gap confirmed as a measured container fact, not an inherited claim. Any audio judgement is [OWNER-ONLY].
envelope_facts_confirmed_on_this_contain.world_bake_present: The world boots and scatters 762,058 props in 43 batches (56,423 harvestable), confirming the grass consolidation is present in this candidate.
envelope_facts_confirmed_on_this_contain.import_cache: Built from scratch on this container: 2,513 imported resources, stable across two consecutive agreeing passes, with zero SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error / Failed to load / ERROR: Cannot open — the same gate .github/actions/setup-godot applies in CI.

owner_only_gaps: Unchanged from section K and asserted by NO evidence in this run: device frame rate, GPU frame time, VRAM, thermals/battery, real controller feel, 7-inch handheld legibility, first-time-human navigation/pacing, voluntary engagement, audio, Windows export identity, true continuous video, long-session device soak, mouse-look feel.

segments_planned._comment_x08: REINSTATED by the owner on 2026-08-27, reversing the drop carried from GATE_F_HANDOVER_2026-08-26_EVENING.md section 7. X08 is now run. Its scope is UNCHANGED by this: section K.1 still makes device frame rate, GPU frame time, VRAM, thermals and battery [OWNER-ONLY] on a software-rasterised Linux container. X08 here yields CPU frame/physics time, draw calls and primitives under this render mode, placement/instance counts, and boot/save/load/transition durations -- nothing that can be read as device performance.
segments_planned._comment_visual_judge: The visual judge is PERMITTED for this candidate: the ordering constraint that held it — X07 auditing a presentation that was about to be replaced by the grass work — is satisfied now that the grass consolidation is on main.

_comment_colour_warning: STANDING WARNING for X07, carried forward and still unresolved. Spot-check colour on a LATE frame against an EARLY one before trusting any batch. In four separate probes on this container every frame after the first in a single process came back hue-rotated — R/B around 2.9-3.9 against a correct 0.42-0.54 — deterministically. Cause UNIDENTIFIED; five explanations eliminated (colour grade, the adjustment_enabled snap at hour 21.0, a live clock outrunning the renderer, the config/blend/weather values, and read-back synchronisation). Two corrections that must travel with it: (1) NIGHT RENDERS CORRECTLY — three independent fresh-process first frames at pinned hour 22 read 0.42-0.44; the earlier severity claim was withdrawn. (2) pin_clock does NOT make X07 immune — the artefact is position-in-process, not clock-driven. X07.json's own note blaming the '2026-08-23 crimson artefact' on an unpinned clock is a WRONG attribution.
